name: Performance Lab
intro: This lab studies speed and timing.
Welcome. Here, order and pace matter.

1: Many small moves wait to be one.
The lab wants a burst, not a stream.
A set of steps hangs in the air.
2: You can queue commands as one batch.
Queued commands run together as one.
A batch either all runs, or none runs.

ok: The batch fires as one. Clean.
error: One bad step, the whole batch is off.

curiosity: Group them. What happens at EXEC?
How many steps can one batch hold?
I wonder if it all lands at once.
humor: MULTI is a queue that loves company.
EXEC is the drumbeat of the lab.
So many commands, so little time.
wisdom: Group small steps into one big step.
A batch protects each other's back.
EXEC is where the magic lands.
sternness: You queued it. Now EXEC it.
No half steps in this lab.
